description: Change an existing draft. Fields left out keep their current values. To clear to, cc or bcc, pass an empty list, and to clear the subject, an empty string. bodyText and bodyHtml replace the whole body together, and attachments replaces all of the attachments. To keep the quoted original when you replace a reply draft's body, pass its replyToMessageId again. A quote Fluxmail added earlier is replaced, not repeated.

accountId.description: Account to operate on. Optional when exactly one account is connected.

contentId.description: Content-ID for an inline image, referenced from bodyHtml as cid:<contentId>

mimeType.description: Defaults to the type for the file extension

path.description: Path relative to the attachment folder

attachmentFiles.description: Files to attach from the attachment folder, ~/.fluxmail/attachments, read by Fluxmail instead of sent as base64. Prefer this to attachments for files on this computer. They are added to the attachments.

items.description: Give content with a filename and mimeType, or messageId and attachmentId

attachmentId.description: With messageId: the attachment ID from get_email

contentId.description: With content: Content-ID for an inline image, referenced from bodyHtml as cid:<contentId>

messageId.description: Instead of content: a message in this mailbox with the attachment to include. Requires mail.read

bodyText.description: Plain-text body. Line breaks appear in the sent email. Keep each prose paragraph on one continuous line and separate paragraphs with blank lines.

from.description: Connected address or an available send-as address

quoteOriginal.description: With replyToMessageId: set to false to leave the original message out of the reply. Defaults to true.

replyAll.description: With replyToMessageId: reply to all original recipients

replyToMessageId.description: Message being replied to; threads correctly, quotes it below the body and computes recipients if "to" is omitted. To continue a conversation, reply to the first message get_thread returns with order newest

timeZone.description: With replyToMessageId: IANA time zone, such as America/New_York, for the date above the quoted message. Defaults to the time zone setting.

name: update_draft
title: Update draft
